narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a rational perspective on the impact of AI on the engineering profession. By addressing the common fear that AI will replace human programmers, the speaker explains that while AI handles the execution of code, humans are still required to provide the logic and instructions. The goal is to reassure students and professionals that these technical skills remain valuable.
